content.value: Explain the purpose of the following with example:
(i) Switch statement, (ii) Nested if-else statements, (iii) Break statement, and (iv) Continue statements.
The income tax is calculated according to the following slabs:
If income is ≤ 3 lac; tax is 0
income is > 3 lac but < 5 lac; tax is 5% of income.
income is > 5 lac but ≤ 10 lac; tax is 10000 + 10% of income above 5 lac.
income is > 10 lac; tax is 60000 + 15% of income above 10 lac.
Write a program to calculate income tax of a person given his income.
